probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means includes a feedback mechanism for adjusting the operation of the first and second valves based on real-time conditions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators or proportional actuators.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, and control braking force based thereon, wherein the control means is further configured to adjust the braking force dynamically based on the detected vehicle conditions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, wherein the control means further includes a predictive algorithm for anticipating braking needs based on vehicle dynamics.
